name: prompt-710
image_purpose: lifestyle collage showing consistent subject, outfit, and bedroom atmosphere

prompt.project_info: Create a cohesive 2x2 UGC photo collage of the same approved adult woman in a sunlit bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with a messy bun, oversized beige knitted sweater, shorts, and cute wool socks; maintain the same identity and outfit in every panel.
prompt.composition_elements: Four panels with thin white borders: high-angle close mirror selfie; chest-up bed portrait; wide floor-mirror reflection while lying on the bed; seated mirror selfie with a paperback book covering the face. Include phone and cozy bedroom details without legible invented book text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft morning sunlight, neutral cream-white-beige palette, intimate lazy-Sunday lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic lifestyle photography, natural skin texture, crisp but gentle detail, 2x2 grid, 4:5 overall portrait canvas, 35mm equivalent lens language, consistent exposure and white balance.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cohesive 2x2 collage of four cozy bedroom mirror-selfie moments featuring the same approved adult woman with a messy bun, oversized beige knitted sweater, shorts, and wool socks. Keep identity, outfit, phone, bedroom, sunlight, and color palette consistent across panels, separated by thin white borders. No explicit content, no legible invented book text, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, inconsistent face, inconsistent outfit, duplicate limbs, distorted hands, warped mirror, mismatched lighting, unreadable text, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Preserve the four-panel composition and consistent identity, outfit, phone, bedroom, and lighting; the identity reference is replaceable only when another approved reference is intentionally attached. Keep typography minimal and non-legible.
